d: Step behind the scenes at Sony Studios with cricket legend Ravichandran Ashwin! In this exclusive "Day in the Life" vlog during the India Tour of New Zealand 2026, Ash takes you through his studio routine from makeup room chess battles and his much-anticipated debut on Extraaa Innings to breaking down the carrom ball in the School of Cricket and answering rapid-fire fan questions. Watch to see what really goes into a full day of broadcasting!
